description: This file implements the PollCallback class for handling polling on file descriptors, including adding file descriptors and polling for events, with callback invocation and error handling.

classes.name: PollCallback
classes.description: A class that manages a set of file descriptors and their associated callbacks, providing methods to add descriptors and poll for events.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor and its callback to the PollCallback instance.

methods.name: Poll
methods.description: Performs polling on the registered file descriptors and executes callbacks for ready descriptors.
